summary: Implemented KAFKA-20282: Added an INFO-level log message to ClassicKafkaConsumer that recommends users switch to the new Consumer rebalance protocol (KIP-848) when they start a consumer using the Classic protocol with a group.id configured. All four required test cases pass: testClassicProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, testConsumerProtocolDoesNotLogRecommendation, testDefaultProtocolLogsRecommendationToTryConsumerProtocol, and testNoGroupIdDoesNotLogGroupProtocolMessage.
